notes: DCGM fractions measure activity, not fraction of peak FLOPS or GB/s.
Conservative 2.2-second guards exclude counter samples crossing request phases.
Prefill window ends at the first answer token across clients; later mixed prefill/decode is excluded.
Decode window starts only after every client has an answer token and ends when the first completes.
Trace kernel durations are diagnostic and can overlap; traced idle is not an untraced budget.
